- **Member ID:** W468430798
- **Reference number:** POC-A0D25E0D66-82168
- **Date of denial notice:** August 5, 2026
- **Service denied:** Lower back disc surgery / decompression, CPT 63030
- **Requesting surgeon:** Marchetti, MD, orthopedic surgery
- **Plan/Product:** Peach State Health Plan, Commercial/ACA (Georgia)
- **Governing policy:** *Clinical Policy: Disc Decompression Procedures (CP.MP.114)*, https://www.ambetterhealth.com/content/dam/centene/ambetteril/clinical-policies/CP.MP.114.pdf

---

Dear Appeals Reviewer,

I am appealing the denial of the lumbar decompression surgery (CPT 63030) requested for me by my surgeon, Dr. Marchetti. The notice dated August 5, 2026 states that the clinical records do not document an adequate trial of conservative treatment before surgery. I am asking the plan to reconsider that decision, because the records already in my file document the conservative care the plan's own policy describes.

I am writing this appeal myself, as the member. My surgeon has documented that this procedure is medically needed, and the findings below come from the records submitted with the prior authorization request.

## The plan's own criteria, and what my records show

All quoted language below is taken from *Clinical Policy: Disc Decompression Procedures (CP.MP.114)*.

**1. Age and diagnosis.** The policy states:

> "A. Age ≥ 18 years; B. Dia gnosis of herniated lumbar disc;"

I am an adult [my date of birth: ________]. My MRI of the lumbar spine dated July 6, 2026 shows an L4-L5 disc extrusion.

**2. Nerve root compression confirmed by imaging.** The policy states:

> "C. Ne rve root compression confirmed by imaging and one of the following:"

The same MRI dated July 6, 2026 shows L4-L5 disc extrusion with severe right lateral recess stenosis and compression of the traversing L5 nerve root. This is nerve root compression confirmed by imaging.

**3. Radiculopathy with sensory deficit.** The policy states:

> "2. Radiculopathy with sensory deficit as evidenced by pain, parasthesias or numbness in a nerve root distribution, and member/enrollee has failed to respond to conservative ther apy including all the following:"

I have radicular pain going down into my right calf. My examination documented positive provocative testing on the affected side and a neurologic deficit corresponding to the level seen on imaging. I have had 12 months of progressive low back pain that is not relieved by rest, and I cannot stand for more than 10 minutes.

**4. Physical therapy.** The policy states:

> "a. ≥ four weeks physical therapy or prescribed home exercise program, or doc umentation of member/enrollee’s inability to tolerate;"

I completed supervised physical therapy — including core stabilization and lumbar flexibility work — for 14 weeks, from April 4, 2026 through July 11, 2026, with 18 visits completed. This is documented in my physical therapy discharge note. Fourteen weeks of supervised therapy is well beyond the four weeks the policy describes.

**5. Medication trial.** The policy states:

> "i. NSAID or acetaminophen ≥ three weeks unless contraindicated or not tolerated;"

I took NSAIDs for 8 months with inadequate relief. I also received a corticosteroid injection on April 29, 2026, which gave me about 3 weeks of partial relief before my symptoms returned.

**6. Activity modification.** The policy states:

> "b. ≥ four weeks activity modification; c. One of the following:"

My daily activity has been substantially limited throughout this period — I cannot stand for more than 10 minutes, and my pain is not relieved by rest. If the plan requires a separately labeled record of activity modification, I ask that this element be identified specifically so it can be supplied: [treating provider documentation of activity modification — dates and description, if recorded in the chart].

## A request for clarity on the criteria applied

Several of the criteria in this policy end in a colon and introduce further sub-conditions that were not reproduced in the excerpts available to me. The policy also contains a separate pathway for motor deficit:

> "1. R adiculopathy with motor deficit and one of the following: a. Severe weakness in a nerve root distribution, as evidenced by: a score of ≤ 3 on the Me dical Research Council 0 to 5 muscle strength scale, or the inability to ambulate;"

and

> "b. Mild to moderate weakness in a nerve root distribution, as evidenced by a score of 4 on the Medical Research Council 0 to 5 muscle strength scale and one of the following:"

> "i. Worsening weakness or motor deficit; ii. Member/enrollee has failed to respond to conservative therapy, within the last year, including all of the following:"

My records document a neurologic deficit corresponding to the imaged level, but I do not have a Medical Research Council muscle strength score in the summary available to me. If the plan applied the motor-deficit pathway, I would ask that this be stated, and my surgeon's office can supply [documented MRC muscle strength grade on examination, if recorded].

Because the denial notice did not identify which specific element of the policy my records were found not to meet, I am asking the plan to state in its response exactly which criterion in *Clinical Policy: Disc Decompression Procedures (CP.MP.114)* it applied and which document it found lacking. That way, if something is genuinely missing, it can be provided rather than guessed at.

## What I am asking for

I respectfully ask Peach State Health Plan to overturn the denial referenced above and authorize CPT 63030 as requested by Dr. Marchetti. In the alternative, I ask that this appeal be reviewed by a physician reviewer in the same or a similar specialty as my surgeon, and that I receive a written explanation identifying the specific policy criterion at issue.

I understand this appeal must be received by **February 1, 2027** (180 days from the August 5, 2026 notice), as stated in the denial notice. I am sending it to the appeal address printed on my denial letter. If there is another filing method the plan would prefer I use, please let me know and I will follow it.

Please contact me at the phone number or email above if any additional records would help. I am glad to have my surgeon's office send anything further that is needed.

**Enclosures (to attach before mailing):**
- Copy of the denial notice dated August 5, 2026 (Reference POC-A0D25E0D66-82168)
- MRI lumbar spine report dated July 6, 2026
- Physical therapy discharge note covering April 4, 2026 – July 11, 2026 (18 visits)
- Office/procedure note for corticosteroid injection dated April 29, 2026
- Surgeon's office notes and letter of medical necessity — Marchetti, MD
- Medication records documenting NSAID trial
- [Any additional records identified by my surgeon's office]

Thank you for your time and for reconsidering this decision.

Sincerely,

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
**Skyler Alvarez**
Member ID: W468430798
Date of birth: [________]
Phone: [________]
Email: [________]
